connectors.name: Zocvi
connectors.description: Finds doctors on Zocvi by specialty, city or free text and reads their public profiles, including qualifications, areas of focus, conditions treated, procedures performed and clinic services, along with selected doctor-written health articles and information on healthcare hiring, in read-only mode with a source link for every result.
connectors.use_case: Finding pediatric cardiologists in a given city, comparing two doctors' qualifications and listed procedures, reading a doctor-written article on a condition before an appointment.

connectors.name: ZTraining Fitness Test
connectors.description: Guides the ZTraining five-minute home fitness baseline with a safety check, scoring balance, sit-and-rise, push-ups, overhead squat and waist-to-height against published research.
connectors.use_case: Scoring a 45-year-old's sit-and-rise and push-up results, finding the one area to train first.

connectors.name: Ритъм МКБ-10
connectors.description: Searches the Bulgarian ICD-10 code list used by the national health information system and returns the diagnosis for a code.
connectors.use_case: Finding the ICD-10 code for hypothyroidism, checking which diagnosis E11.9 means.

connectors.name: ウェリー（issin）
connectors.description: Reads a member's own Welly records from issin's smart bath mat, smart ring and food log, including weight trends, sleep times and meal nutrition summaries, without changing them.
connectors.use_case: Seeing why Monday weight runs higher than other days, preparing a 90-day weight and sleep note for a checkup.
